question: What lack of devotion disqualifies a person from receiving the teaching?
premises: A person may be devoid of devotion to the kula
A person may be deprived of devotion to the guru
Both lacks are presented as disqualifying conditions
inference: Those lacking devotion to both the kula and the guru are unfit recipients.
plain_english: Indeed, in one who is devoid of devotion to the kula and deprived of devotion to the guru...
